meaning:
λιθο-βολέω, -ῶ
(λίθος, βάλλω), [in LXX for סָקַל, רָגַם, Exo.19:13, Lev.20:2, al. ;]
to pelt with stones, to kill by stoning, to stone (cf. λιθάζω): with accusative of person(s), Mat.21:35 23:37, Luk.13:34 Act.7:58-59 14:5; pass., Heb.12:20 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers…
They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
